answer_1.quote: we investigate how well language models, specifically BERT Large, perform on the linguistically interesting task of article prediction.

answer_2.quote: we evaluate performance based on the Matthews correlation coefficient between human annotators and model outputs

answer_4.quote: Participants were presented with individual examples consisting of three sentences each, wherein the central sentence had exactly one article omitted and replaced with a blank space.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were required to select which article had been omitted from a multiple-choice list that was presented below the sentences.
